info.name: SD Mapper V2 compatible test cartridge with the m6 kernel ROM and an m6 block device that offers Turbo with no mapper behind it
info.description: The SD Mapper V2 cartridge with the m6 kernel ROM (build/m6-sdmapper.rom, copied into the ROM pool by the harness) presenting the m6 block device's registers with Turbo offered and a mapper claimed in subslot 3 where there is none: a cartridge that lies, for the kernel ROM's boot to refuse; one card, the image given with -hda.
